next_action: Commit phase 1; in phase 2, make `ls-tree` execution/ref failures fail closed before wiring the view into `scanIntake`.

observations.detail: `listHeadTreeEntries` currently converts every `git ls-tree` failure to `[]`, not just an absent ticket root. Once phase 2 consumes its ticket IDs, an unreadable HEAD/ref or git execution failure could look like “no tickets” and skip intake checks. This phase has no production wiring, so it is non-blocking here, but phase 2 should distinguish valid empty output from command failure and add a regression test.
